messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for model-service v12 in us-east-1. Service SLO (p99 < 200ms) breached at 14:02 UTC; sustained for ~3m. auto-ticket=#INC-3456 :rotating_light:

sam: seeing it on the dashboard. p95 is OK-ish (~120ms) but p99 jumped to ~1.2s and streaming stalls are visible. I’m taking pager.

maria: noted, oncall handoff to sam acknowledged. any customer-visible errors? support-bot: 5% 5xx increase correlated with same window, mostly upstream timeouts from streaming proxies.

alex: looks like the rollout to v12 started 13:45 UTC with a 20% traffic ramp. Could be model change/kv cache miss pattern. dumps attached to the deploy log show increased encoder latency.

josh: replays of recent requests show KV fetches stalling on a subset of shards. suspecting a local thrash with the new kv eviction heuristics in v12.

amanda (support-bot): we have one enterprise customer (acme-corp) reporting slow responses on live chat, ticket INC-3456 linked to their org. CS is pinged.

sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause rollout/cut traffic to v12, 2) roll back to v11, 3) route streaming requests to fallback model variant (v12-lite). What’s quickest?

maria: pausing rollout in controller now. patching traffic routemap to pin stable=80% v11, canary=0%. Doing a quick traffic shift to v11.

alex: if we shift traffic back to v11 we might avoid dense cache warmup cost. I can trigger rollback if ops wants.

sam: do it. prefer rollback rather than partial live mitigation unless we need to keep canary for debugging. Instructions: use infra rollback tool.

josh: quick sanity check on scaling: autoscaler for encoder pool didn't increase because pod readiness gated by new model load times. Scaling up new pods won't help until model warmup completes.

sam: running rollback command now:
```
$ redwoodctl rollout rollback model-service --to v11 --region us-east-1 --reason "p99 spike"
```

alex: CLI reported rollout started, shifting 100% of canary back to v11, controller will ramp over 30s.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout change applied; canary->v11 traffic mapping updated. Observability note pinned to INC-3456.

maria: I'm watching live charts. p99 dropped to ~400ms after shift started. still trending.

sam: add temporary traffic-shed rule for streaming-heavy routes to prefer lower-latency fallback model. Command below to add route: 
```
$ redwoodctl route patch /chat/streaming --prefer-model v11-lite --region us-east-1
```

ej (alex): applied route prefer. That should reduce stalls for long-poll sessions.

josh: log snippet from an affected instance before rollback:
```
[2026-03-14T13:58:12Z] encoder.latency=1200ms KV_FETCH_WAIT=980ms shard=3
[2026-03-14T13:58:13Z] kv.lock_wait=620ms retry_count=2
```

elaine: CS update: ACME chat latency improved after 14:06 UTC, they confirmed partial recovery. Marking customer impact as "degraded" instead of "outage" for now.

amanda (support-bot): ticket INC-3456 updated: "Mitigation applied, rollback initiated, monitoring for recovery."

sam: Observability baseline: p95 ~110ms, p99 trending ~210-260ms now — slightly above SLO but much better than 1.2s. Keep monitoring for 15m.

maria: opening a post-incident task to investigate kv eviction heuristics in v12 and to add canary performance gates based on tail latency for streaming routes.

alex: action items: (1) reproduce load pattern in staging with v12 and kv settings; (2) add a canary check for p99 on streaming endpoints before auto-ramp; (3) add runbook step to auto-pin fallback when p99 > 500ms for 2m.

josh: I'll instrument extra histograms around kv wait and add alerting for kv.lock_wait > 200ms / shard.

sam: oncall handback: if nothing else flares, I'll hand back to maria in 20m. maria, you good to take the follow-up?

maria: yep, taking follow-up. will coordinate with alex/josh on the postmortem and a safe re-release plan.

deploy-bot: NOTE: monitoring will page if p99 > 500ms for 3m. Add comment to INC-3456 with mitigation steps and rollback details.

elaine: quick customer comms draft for ACME: "We're rolling back a recent model change that caused intermittent slow responses. We're monitoring recovery and will follow up with a root cause and timeline for fix." send when stable.

amanda (support-bot): sent. ACME replied: "thanks, noticed big improvement" :thumbsup:

sam: closing active paging for this incident in 10m if p99 stays <300ms. Postmortem owner: alex. Timeline owner: maria.

maria: noted. logging the incident category as "rollout-induced tail latency" and priority=P2.

sam: final status update pinned to thread: rollback complete, customer impact contained, postmortem in progress. Oncall handback to maria at 14:25 UTC.

support-bot: Incident INC-3456 updated to RESOLVED (mitigated).

maria: thanks everyone. following up with a deeper investigation and a plan to harden canary gating.

sam: thanks team, nice quick coordination. :raised_hands:
